records.title: STATUS OF SAFE AND TRUSTED AI PILLAR UNDER INDIAAI MISSION
details:
● 27 India Data and AI Labs have been established, which has supported training for more 
than 2500 students 
● Work ongoing on additional 188 labs. 
AI Centres of Excellence: 
58 Artificial Intelligence Centres of Excellence (AI-CoEs) being established across States and 
Union Territories in collaboration with the respective State/UT Governments and industry 
partners.
